summary: Fastidious previews Season 9, 'The Undertow Approach,' detailing 10 new heroes, 7 new gear sets, 4 mythic artifacts, and the Duskport map region featuring the Invertipulis Sentinel boss. The season introduces three new elemental affinity pairings: Necrotoxin (Necrosis/Poison), Frostlight (Radiance/Ice), and Firestorm (Lightning/Fire). Legendary hero Anneliesis makes a highly anticipated return on November 8th. Players can also obtain legendary hero Amalfriede and epic hero Quirro for free through seasonal events, alongside up to 7 Heliolite Dice from the Halloween Candy Bean Battle event.

heroes.name: Anneliesis
heroes.note: Returns November 8th; brings crowd control, state manipulation, and team buffs via Possess.

heroes.name: Amalfriede
heroes.note: Obtainable free in S9 seasonal events; inflicts debuffs and increases her own damage based on debuffs applied.

heroes.name: Quirro
heroes.note: Obtainable free in S9 seasonal events; dispels enemy shields and transfers enemy buffs to allies.

heroes.name: Sia
heroes.note: Reduces damage taken by allies, grants Parry, and deals Necrotic damage.

heroes.name: Celestine
heroes.note: Stores damage taken to heal allies and increases allies' Max HP.

heroes.name: Syonis
heroes.note: Lowers enemy Defense and enters an Energy Drain Zone against targeted enemies.

heroes.name: Rhyviel
heroes.note: Lowers enemy Defense, inflicts Corrosion, and deals massive True Damage.

heroes.name: Holfast
heroes.note: Channels Aura Energy to allies and grants team buffs.

heroes.name: Fyrenzur
heroes.note: Grants Dodge to allies and reflects damage after a successful Dodge.

heroes.name: Longbeau
heroes.note: Provides Healing Over Time, dispels negative effects, and reflects debuffs.

heroes.name: Tallyn
heroes.note: Inflicts Control on enemies and grants Shields to allies.

tips: Save Heliolite Dice and Wyrmarrow for the return of Anneliesis on November 8th.
New and returning players should use the Account Appraisal page within 14 days of account creation to claim up to 15,000 Wyrmarrow.
Participate daily in the Halloween Candy Bean Battle by spending 150 stamina to unlock challenges that reward 7 total Heliolite Dice.
Earn free heroes Amalfriede (Legendary) and Quirro (Epic) by playing seasonal events like Continental Challenge and Fey Meander.
